column1: # Deskripsi skill — keluarga mekanik putaran keenam.
# Nama faksi/unit (Girard Group, Boss, Sentry (HMG/GL)) dan nama nilai
# (HOC Power, Precision value) dibawa backref / tetap Inggris.
# --- target khusus ---
# Kelas karakter dibatasi (bukan ".+"): dengan ".+" pola ini rakus dan menelan
# kalimat majemuk seperti "...is increased by 2.5% and damage dealt to X units...",
# menghasilkan terjemahan setengah jadi. Kelas ini tidak bisa melewati "%" atau ".".
^Damage dealt to ([A-Za-z][\w' -]*) units is increased by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color>\.$
column2: Damage ke unit \1 meningkat sebesar \2\3%</color>.

column1: ^Damage taken from the inflictor of this status effect is increased by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color>\.$
column2: Damage dari pihak yang menimbulkan status ini meningkat sebesar \1\2%</color>.

column1: # --- pengurangan & efek bertahan ---
^Damage reduction from cover is reduced by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color>\.$
column2: Pengurangan damage dari Cover berkurang sebesar \1\2%</color>.

column1: ^Damage reduction from stability is reduced by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color>\.$
column2: Pengurangan damage dari Stability berkurang sebesar \1\2%</color>.

column1: ^Targeted damage taken is reduced by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color>\.$
column2: Damage tertarget yang diterima berkurang sebesar \1\2%</color>.

column1: ^Stability damage taken reduced by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+) points?</color>\.$
column2: Damage Stability yang diterima berkurang sebesar \1\2 poin</color>.

column1: ^Healing effects are reduced by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color>\.$
column2: Efek healing berkurang sebesar \1\2%</color>.

column1: ^While below (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color> HP, becomes immune to all sources of damage\.$
column2: Saat HP di bawah \1\2%</color>, kebal terhadap semua sumber damage.

column1: # --- serangan & stat ---
^Targeted active skill damage increased by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color>, effective once\.$
column2: Damage skill aktif tertarget meningkat sebesar \1\2%</color>, berlaku sekali.

column1: ^Damage dealt by Ultimate skills is increased by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color>\.$
column2: Damage dari Ultimate skill meningkat sebesar \1\2%</color>.

column1: ^When making out-of-turn attacks, attack is increased by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color>\.$
column2: Saat melakukan serangan di luar giliran, Attack meningkat sebesar \1\2%</color>.

column1: ^When a weakness is exploited when taking damage, damage taken is increased by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color>\.$
column2: Saat kelemahan tereksploitasi ketika menerima damage, damage yang diterima meningkat sebesar \1\2%</color>.

column1: ^Attack is increased by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color> and Max HP is increased by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color>\.$
column2: Attack meningkat sebesar \1\2%</color> dan Max HP meningkat sebesar \3\4%</color>.

column1: ^Damage multiplier against the selected target is further increased to (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d+ .]+)%</color> of (.+)\.$
column2: Damage multiplier terhadap target terpilih naik lagi jadi \1\2%</color> dari \3.

column1: # --- efek area & sekutu ---
^The defense of all allied units with (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)(\{\d+\})</color> is increased by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color>\.$
column2: Defense semua unit sekutu yang memiliki \1\2</color> meningkat sebesar \3\4%</color>.

column1: ^When ally units exploit a phase weakness, they recover HP equal to (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color> of Max HP\.$
column2: Saat unit sekutu mengeksploitasi kelemahan phase, mereka memulihkan HP sebesar \1\2%</color> dari Max HP.

column1: ^If any allied unit within (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+) tiles</color> is hit by an active attack, restores their HP equal to (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color> of attack\.$
column2: Jika ada unit sekutu dalam \1\2 tile</color> terkena serangan aktif, HP-nya dipulihkan sebesar \3\4%</color> dari Attack.

column1: ^Any enemy target that enters (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+) tiles</color> around the user will have (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)(\{\d+\})</color> temporarily removed\.$
column2: Target musuh mana pun yang masuk \1\2 tile</color> di sekitar pengguna akan kehilangan \3\4</color> untuk sementara.

column1: ^When this effect reaches (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+) stacks</color>, removes them and gains (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)(\{\d+\})</color>\.$
column2: Saat efek ini mencapai \1\2 stack</color>, stack-nya dihapus dan mendapatkan \3\4</color>.

column1: ^If this unit has (\w+) buffs, damage taken is reduced by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color>, damage dealt is increased by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color> and critical rate is increased by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color>\.$
column2: Jika unit ini memiliki buff \1, damage yang diterima berkurang sebesar \2\3%</color>, damage yang diberikan meningkat sebesar \4\5%</color>, dan Critical Rate meningkat sebesar \6\7%</color>.

column1: # --- serangan bertarget ganda ---

^Select 1 enemy target on (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)Peripheral Battlefield ([\d.]+)</color> or the Core Battlefield, deal Physical damage to it equal to (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d+ .]+)%</color> of (.+) and deal Physical damage to all enemy units (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)within ([\d.]+) tiles</color> equal to (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d+ .]+)%</color> of (.+)\.$
column2: Pilih 1 target musuh di \1Peripheral Battlefield \2</color> atau Core Battlefield, berikan damage Physical sebesar \3\4%</color> dari \5, dan berikan damage Physical ke semua unit musuh \6dalam \7 tile</color> sebesar \8\9%</color> dari \g<10>.

column1: # --- teks tutorial/objektif di rentang ini ---
^Click the supply box to pick it up, reducing incoming damage by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color> for ([\d.]+) turns?\.$
column2: Klik supply box untuk mengambilnya, mengurangi damage masuk sebesar \1\2%</color> selama \3 giliran.

column1: ^Damage taken by the enemy command vehicle is reduced by ([\d.]+)% for each Sentry \(HMG\) and Sentry \(GL\)\.$
column2: Damage yang diterima kendaraan komando musuh berkurang \1% untuk setiap Sentry (HMG) dan Sentry (GL).

column1: ^Unlocks when the North Sea Underground Brokers' Merchant Association Reputation reaches Lv\.$
column2: Terbuka saat Reputasi Merchant Association North Sea Underground Brokers mencapai Lv.
